map.由代扣金额与征收率求代扣代缴税额 使用指南: Withheld Tax from the Withheld Amount and Collection Rate User Guide
map.输入代扣代付金额与征收率，按 税额=金额×征收率 计算代扣代缴的增值税或税费，用: Enter the withheld amount and the collection rate, and the tax = amount × collection rate formula gives the VAT or tax to be withheld and remitted, for quick calculation of the tax a payer owes under a withholding obligation.
map.代扣代缴 = 代扣金额×征收率: Withheld tax = withheld amount × collection rate
map.输入代扣金额与征收率，求代扣代缴税额。: Enter the withheld amount and the collection rate to compute the tax to be withheld and remitted.
map.跨境服务、特定业务由购买方代扣代缴 VAT/税。: For cross-border services and specific businesses the buyer withholds and remits the VAT or tax.
map.已知代扣基数与率，算代缴额。: Given the withholding base and the rate, compute the withheld tax.
map.境外供应商无机构时境内买方履行扣缴。: When an overseas supplier has no entity, the domestic buyer performs the withholding.
map.：代扣代缴 T = 5000 × 0.03 = 150 元；基数翻倍到 1000: Withheld tax T = 5000 × 0.03 = 150 CNY; doubling the base to 10000 gives 300 CNY withheld.
map.：若 5000 为含税价、率 3%，则不含税 = 5000/1.03 ≈ 485: If 5000 is the tax-inclusive price and the rate is 3%, the pre-tax amount = 5000/1.03 ≈ 4854 and the withheld tax ≈ 145.63 CNY.
map.由缴费基数与社保费率求社保费: Social insurance contribution from the contribution base and the rate
map.由应税数量与单位税额求从量税: Specific tax from the taxable quantity and the unit tax
map.税额 = 凭证金额 × 印花税率: Tax = document amount × stamp duty rate
map.本应由销售方缴的税，改由购买方在付款时扣缴并申报，常见于跨境服务。: Tax that the seller should have paid is instead withheld and declared by the buyer at the time of payment, common in cross-border services.
map.代缴后销售方还缴吗？: After the buyer withholds, does the seller still pay?
map.销售方不再就该笔在境内缴，由买方扣缴完成纳税义务。: The seller no longer pays that tax domestically; the buyer withholds it, which completes the tax obligation.
